Exhaustive DPLL analysis over the 16 flag bits (f32..f47) shows policy_d ∧ policy_e is unsatisfiable (every case on f44/f47/f35 refuted by unit propagation against the source clauses, e.g. f44=0,f47=0,f35=0 forces f34=1, f43=0, f46=0, f42=0, f40=1, f32=1, f36=0, f33=1, violating !f33||f43||!f34). Hence stage3 never returns 3 and lookup_user always runs the constant parameterized statement via db_exec_param; the quote-doubling loop and snprintf sizes are also correctly bounded, so no overflow.
